acc_001.subject: Re: Workflow templates — tax season setup
acc_001.snippet: Thanks for sending those templates over. We got the 1040 workflow running yesterday and the team loves the automation. Can you send the one for business returns too?

acc_001.subject: Question about client portal customization
acc_001.snippet: Hi, one of our staff is asking whether we can add our logo to the client-facing portal. Is that on the business plan?

acc_001.subject: QBR follow-up — action items
acc_001.snippet: Great catching up today. As agreed: I'll send the bulk email training video, and you'll loop in Sarah for the onboarding of the two new hires.

acc_002.subject: We haven't been using TaxDome much
acc_002.snippet: Hi, just wanted to flag that the team has kind of gone back to our old email workflow. We're not sure TaxDome is saving us time yet. Is there a simpler way to set this up?

acc_002.subject: Re: Check-in — how are things going?
acc_002.snippet: Honestly not great. The onboarding felt rushed and we're still confused about workflows. We haven't migrated our client list over either.

acc_002.subject: Renewal coming up in July
acc_002.snippet: Just a heads up that your renewal is coming up July 1. I'd love to schedule a call to make sure you're getting value before then.

acc_003.subject: Automation for onboarding new clients
acc_003.snippet: We've been playing with the automation rules and built a full onboarding sequence. It's saving us probably 3 hours per new client. Really happy with it.

acc_003.subject: Re: Can we add more seats for the new hires?
acc_003.snippet: We're bringing on 3 more staff in Q3 — what does adding seats look like on our current plan?

acc_003.subject: Re: Seat fill / utilization
acc_003.snippet: Glad the automations are working well. On the seat question — I'll get you pricing options. We might also want to revisit which plan tier fits your growth.

acc_004.subject: Re: Love the new task view
acc_004.snippet: The team is using TaxDome for everything now — scheduling, billing, even our internal task tracking. Best decision we made last year.

acc_004.subject: Need 2 more seats — adding junior staff
acc_004.snippet: We're at capacity. Bringing on two new juniors next month. What's the process to upgrade?

acc_005.subject: Re: Are we able to expand?
acc_005.snippet: We're basically maxed on seats. Tax season brought in 4 new staff and we've been sharing logins which I know is not ideal. Can we get a quote for 30 seats?

acc_005.subject: Renewal question
acc_005.snippet: Our renewal is coming up June 15. We definitely want to stay — TaxDome has been transformational for us. But we need to sort out the seat situation first.

acc_006.subject: Is someone available to walk us through workflows?
acc_006.snippet: We signed up 6 months ago and we've mostly just been using it for document storage. A partner asked if we can use it more strategically — can we get a training session?

acc_006.subject: Re: Check-in April
acc_006.snippet: Following up on our call — I sent a recording of the workflow setup webinar. Let me know if it would help to do a live session with your team.

acc_006.subject: No reply
acc_006.snippet: Hi again — just wanted to make sure you got my last message. Happy to find a time that works for the team. Even 30 min could get you unblocked.

acc_007.subject: Re: QBR notes
acc_007.snippet: All good on our end. The client portal has really helped with document collection — clients are responding way faster than before.

acc_007.subject: Quick win — bulk email
acc_007.snippet: Noticed you haven't tried the bulk email feature yet. Given how many clients you message for deadlines, I think it could save you real time. Want me to do a quick demo?

acc_008.subject: Re: Renewal — Harbor View
acc_008.snippet: We're evaluating options before the June 30 renewal. We like the platform but feel like we're not using it to its potential. Would want to see a roadmap before committing.

acc_008.subject: Executive sponsor changed
acc_008.snippet: Just a heads up — David Chen who was our main TaxDome champion left the firm last month. The new ops manager, Priya Sharma, is reviewing all our tools.

acc_008.subject: Re: Usage review
acc_008.snippet: Thanks for the update on David. Happy to schedule a call with Priya to walk through what the team has built and where there's room to grow. Availability this week?

acc_008.subject: No reply to last 2 outreaches
acc_008.snippet: Piera — flagging that Harbor View hasn't responded to my last two emails. Might be worth a call. Their renewal is June 30.
